proposals.evidence: The sweet branch of mr̥ṣṭa/miṣṭa explicitly gives Assamese miṭhā and Bengali miṭha; the addendum records Assamese phonetic mitha/mita. Hajong mithu therefore fits the eastern sweet series with its source dental spelling and final u, without inventing a separate root from the dental notation.

proposals.evidence: Turner gives Prakrit titta, Assamese titā and Bengali tita/titā bitter under tikta. Hajong titu preserves this dental t-t bitter stem with regional final u; it is not assigned to the separate retroflex bitter family which Turner discusses as an alternative for Torwali.
